forward_diagnostics.uncertainty_caveat: Only three test sessions; exhaustive day-block resampling is descriptive, not a reliable population confidence interval.

promotion_reason: Four sessions and unstable forward-day direction quality do not establish a deployable edge; small scores must not be amplified to fill the range.

runtime_model.reachability: (1-exp(-5*(atr_fraction/0.002)^2)) * (1-exp(-minutes_remaining/5)); structural heuristic, not a first-passage probability

selection_caveat: These folds influenced model selection and are not an untouched final test. Only four correlated sessions were studied. No dates after September 4 were scored or labelled.
